senses.gloss:
झष् झष्, cl. 1. P. A. झषति, -ते, &c.,
to take; to put on, wear, cover; (only P.)
to hurt or kill.

झष, अस्, m. a large fish, a fish in general; the
sign of the zodiac Pisces; a forest, a thicket; a
forest overgrown with grass; heat, warmth; (आ), f.
the plant Uraria Lagopodioides; (अम्), n. a desert.
—झष-केतन or झष-ध्वज, अस्, m. a N.
of Kandarpa or the god of love; love.
—झषाङ्क
(˚ष-अङ्˚), अस्, m. an epithet of Aniruddha or the
son of Kāma.
—झषाशन (˚ष-अश्˚), अस्, m. the
Gangetic porpoise, Delphinus Gangeticus.
—झषो-
दरी (˚ष-उद्˚), f. an epithet of Satyavatī, the wife
of Sāntanu and mother of Vyāsa.
